lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: The arrangement consists of approximately five discernible vertical columns of high-luminance spots posterior to the gill slits. The first column contains 4 nodes, followed by columns of 5, 4, and 3 nodes respectively, forming a semi-regular staggered grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to define a mesh-like grid structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single, prominent horizontal linear ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with higher intensity on the dorsal side and deep shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-density population of smaller, lower-luminance spots that are distinct from the larger, more organized constellation on the lateral flank.
